entities.summary: Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn  is a Japanese novel series by Harutoshi Fukui with character designs by Yoshikazu Yasuhiko and mechanical designs by Hajime Katoki. It was serialized in Gundam Ace from 2007 to 2009 and compiled into ten volumes, with an additional volume released in 2016; the story is set in Universal Century 0096 as a sequel to Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack.
